children: is the lead bidder to purchase Palmer Square Capital Management, a credit manager that oversees more than $37 billion.
No final decision has been made, and the discussions could still fall apart, according to a  Bloomberg report on Tuesday, which cited people familiar with the matter.
Goldman declined to comment to Bloomberg, and Palmer Square didn’t respond to requests for comment.
The news today comes after Bloomberg reported earlier this month that Palmer Square was exploring a sale of its business.
